name: error-unsupported-layer-in-stack
description: An unsupported layer inside a stack names both the failing token and the whole header.
grounding: With stacked codings the token alone does not say which header produced it, and the header alone does not say which layer failed. Both are required in the message; this is the one place the corpus asserts message content, because the message content is the contract.
notes: The body is plaintext: the outer layer is rejected before anything is decoded, so what the bytes are cannot matter — and a case where it did would be hiding a decode attempt.
